messages:
mira: Quick accessibility/a11y pass on the GPU pool selector chips — noticed a couple of issues when testing with VoiceOver.
alex: thanks, what did you hit specifically?
mira: primary one: chip labels read out as the visual text only. when a chip includes a burst badge the screen reader says 'pool name burst' but we need explicit role & state: e.g., 'gpu pool <name>, selected, burst available'.
sam: yeah that makes sense. I think our chips are just <button> with inner text. ARIA could clarify.
mira: exactly. propose: aria-label="GPU pool {name}, {selected|not selected}, burst capacity {on|off}". also add aria-pressed for the toggle state.
alex: sounds good. small worry: long aria-labels can be noisy. could we keep it concise? maybe split with aria-describedby pointing to hidden hint element that says 'burst available' when relevant.
jess: +1 for concise labeling + describedby. Also keyboard focus ring is super thin on high-contrast mode — Sam can you bump to 3px or use the system focus token? :eyes:
sam: noted. I'll use the focus token and test with high contrast.
aria-bot: Automated a11y scan results: Contrast ratio warnings on .pool-chip .badge (ratio 3.1:1), missing aria-pressed on interactive chips. See /a11y/reports/1895123456.
mira: thanks @aria-bot. For the SLO slider: tooltip overlaps the chip rail when you drag near the right edge — screen magnifier users can lose context.
alex: can we clamp the tooltip or flip it above when within 120px of rail edge?
sam: implement flip-by-space algorithm, and add a small callout arrow so the association is clearer. also animate reduce motion respecting prefers-reduced-motion.
jess: microcopy nit: slider label 'Target latency' should include units 'ms' and a short helper 'p99 target' — currently people think it's average.
mira: good catch. Suggest copy: 'SLO target (p99 latency, ms)' and in tooltip 'Measured at p99 over 5m window'.
alex: love it. Last UX thing: burst override modal copy feels scary — 'Force burst now' triggers support tickets. Can we soften language to 'Allow temporary burst' with a 1-line explanation and a countdown in the CTA?
sam: I'll update modal copy + add a 5s delay before the CTA becomes active to prevent accidental clicks.
jess: accessibility checkbox: ensure modal gets focus trap and `aria-modal="true"`, and that the initial focus goes to the primary explanation, not the CTA.
mira: perfect. I'll spin a tiny PR with copy + aria-label suggestions and ping the thread.
alex: thanks! one last ask — can someone add a tiny test in Cypress that validates aria-pressed toggles and tooltip flip? low effort smoke test.
sam: on it, will add to the autoscale e2e file.
jess: updated Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/pool-chip-a11y — comments pinned on the right. :thumbsup:
mira: awesome. I'll follow up after the PR lands and we'll run a11y scan again.
aria-bot: Reminder: schedule re-scan in 24h.
